messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Legend diagonal lines
parts:
Felipe, the code in the other post you sent describes your issue. I don't know how to do it but I have an ugly workaround. I added geom_polygon without color="blue", which will make a nice legend, and plot on top of it the geom with blue borders.


utah_basins <- ggplot(shp2,aes(long,lat,group=group,fill=level3_nam)) +
 geom_polygon() + geom_polygon(colour="blue", legend = F)
 utah_basins

HTH

Luciano
